content_sections.heading: DHGMC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. DHGMC/2026/2192/1(14) gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DHGMC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master degree in Molecular Biology / Biochemistry / Microbiology / Biotechnology Experience: Desirable: experience in RT-PCR in any recognized university / laboratory would be preferred Age limit: 21 to 45 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: Service can be renewed on six months interval No TA/DA will be paid for interview Desirable: Ph.D in a related subject from a recognized Institute Experience in RT-PCR in any recognized university / laboratory would be preferred Higher qualification and experience beyond the essential qualification in the relevant discipline will be an advantage for short listing

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary and contractual basis under the RT-PCR Laboratory Period up to 28.02.2027 or completion of the project, whichever is earlier Can be renewed at six-month intervals considering satisfactory services Service may be terminated without prior intimation if performance is not satisfactory; next candidate from the panel will be called

rows.event: Last date for submission of application form (before 04:00 P.M)

content_sections.heading: How Will DHGMC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Verification of Academic Qualification and Work experience in the relevant field (40 marks) Viva-Voce (10 marks) Academic qualification and experience: 40 marks in total Master degree in Molecular Biology / Biochemistry / Microbiology / Biotechnology: 15 marks Experience: 20 marks - 5 marks per completed year in Govt. organization, 2 marks per completed year in Private organization The decision of the Expert Committee will be final

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Photo proof identity card (preferably Aadhaar Card, else Passport / Voter card / PAN card / Driving License) - original Age proof certificate (Admit card of Madhyamik or equivalent examination) - original Mark sheets of all examinations quoted by the candidate - original All experience certificates issued and stamped by the appropriate authority of a recognized institution, from oldest to latest - original

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHGMC Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Fill up the application form through the online portal https://www.dhgmc.edu.in/recruitment. Online registration is open from 18/11/2026 (10:00 A.M) to 24/11/2026 (before 04:00 P.M). No other mode of application will be accepted; such applications will be summarily rejected. An application once submitted cannot be modified, so furnish correct details before submitting. Bring original documents for verification whenever asked for.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Application forms not properly filled in, incomplete or with wrong entries are liable to be cancelled An application whose details differ from the original testimonials is liable to be cancelled The expert committee reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without any reason Follow https://www.dhgmc.edu.in from time to time for updates
